s.note: rationed between George and Gwen through one very long night
s.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale. Mix in 250g plain flour and 50g cornflour to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 25 to 30 minutes until pale golden. Cut into 24 fingers while warm and cool in the tin. Sandwich pairs with 120g raspberry jam and dust with icing sugar.

s.note: the flight that gets diverted to Boston, and nothing left to eat on board
s.how: Simmer 500g cocktail franks in water for 3 minutes and drain. In a frying pan melt 20g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Add the franks and toss over medium heat for 5 minutes until sticky and glazed. Serve on toothpicks with cocktail onions.

m.note: the hotel they're trying to reach
m.how: Toast 80g walnuts. Dice 2 apples and 3 celery sticks and halve 200g grapes. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp crème fraîche and the juice of half a lemon, fold everything through and season. Spoon onto leaves of 1 butter lettuce.

w.how: Crush 200g digestive biscuits with 80g melted butter and press into a 22cm tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g caster sugar, 200g sour cream and 3 eggs until smooth. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 70 minutes, then cool in the oven and chill overnight. Top with 250g sliced strawberries.

d.how: Freeze four martini glasses for 30 minutes. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a frozen glass with a green olive. Makes four with 240ml gin.
